metadata.description: Agent skills for using kubuszok's Scala libraries (Hearth, Kindlings, ...) - one plugin per library.

plugins.name: hearth
plugins.description: Skills for writing Scala 2.13/3 macros with Hearth: cross-quotes, MIO, CaseClass/Enum, type class derivation, standard extensions, debugging.

plugins.name: kindlings
plugins.description: Skills for using Kindlings: type class derivation for circe, jsoniter-scala, cats, avro, pureconfig, tapir, yaml, xml, scalacheck and more, plus di, mock, optics and parser modules.

plugins.name: sbt-kubuszok
plugins.description: Skills for adopting the sbt-kubuszok sbt plugin: what it already configures (git versioning, Maven Central publishing, ci-release, scalafmt), build layout with projectType/Aliases/DevProperties, GitHub Actions CI and release workflows, and troubleshooting failed publishes.

plugins.name: baltic-porter
plugins.description: Skills and guard hooks for repositories that generate Scala 3 sources from Java with Baltic Porter: configuring and customizing a port, reading what a run could not handle, tracing a generated defect to its rule, bumping the engine pin, the local gate before a push, cross-platform rows and CI caching.

plugins.name: multiarch-scala
plugins.description: Skills for using multiarch-scala: cross-platform JVM/Scala.js/Scala Native builds, native library provider JARs, NativeLibLoader, Panama FFM, zig cross-linking, JVM release packaging, Android APKs without Gradle, cross-platform resources and ServiceLoader.

plugins.name: re-scale-hooks
plugins.description: The re-scale PreToolUse guard hook for any repository: denies shell grep/find/ls/sed/awk, pipes into head/tail/wc, bare sbt, rm, kill, destructive git and secret-file access, asks before unknown git and GitHub state changes, and auto-approves everything else; rules extend in .rescale/claude-hooks.yaml.

plugins.name: re-scale-porting
plugins.description: Skills and agents for porting libraries to Scala 3 with the re-scale CLI: conversion guides (Java, Dart, Ruby), shortcut and stub scans, file-header metadata, migration/audit/issue tracking, and the implement-audit loop. Pair with re-scale-hooks.
